newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway Central Bank appoints external portfolio manager.
newsitem.headline: Norway Central Bank appoints external portfolio manager.

text.p: Norway's Central Bank said on Monday it had entered agreements with ABN AMBRO Asset Management (UK) in London and Goldman Sachs Asset Management in New York to outsource management of parts of its foreign exchange reserves.

ABN AMBRO will manage a fixed-income portfolio valued at 150 million marks. The portfolio can be invested in instruments denominated in marks, French francs, sterling, guilders, Belgian francs, Danish crowns, Swedish crowns and European Currency Units.
Goldman Sachs will manage a fixed-income portfolio for a total value of $100 million. The portfolio can be invested in instruments denominated in American and Canadian dollars.

The bank said the agreements would provide a tool for comparing its own financial management with that carried out by international managers and to establish closer copperation with such institutions.
The management companies will assume responsibility for the portfolios from January 17, it said.
